column1: # FORMAT: machine-ledger
# DOC_ID: <project-or-crt>/decision-ledger
# DOC_CURRENCY: CURRENT (STATE face) + APPEND_ONLY (HISTORY face)
# AUTHORITY_CLASS: A1_CURRENT_OWNER
# VERIFICATION_STATUS: N/A (this IS the decision/adjudication record)
# TASK_STATUS: ACTIVE
# AS_OF: <ISO-8601 + tz>
# TOPIC_ID: decision-ledger
# DDC_CATEGORY: DDC-11 (HYBRID)
# SUPERSEDES: -   ; SUPERSEDED_BY: -
#   (in-band STATUS header above; TSV-preamble exception. If preferred, bind these bytes with a
#    hash-bound companion sidecar decision-ledger.sha256 instead.)
# PURPOSE (DDC-11): 'chose X over Y, why, when, on what deciding evidence' + resolutions of
#   contradictions between sources. Keeps selection-vs-architecture honest and records conflicting
#   claims rather than silently merging them.
# HYBRID CONTRACT:
#   STATE face   = current decision_state / resolution_status per row; supersede a row IN PLACE on transition.
#   HISTORY face = append-only dated adjudication trail (never edit a past line).
# DECISION_STATE vocab (single atomic token — separates EXISTENCE from ADOPTION from EFFICACY; NO concatenated qualifiers):
#   PROPOSED (exists, not adopted) -> ADOPTED (adopted, efficacy untested) -> EFFECTIVE (adopted + measured-effective, see DDC-14)
#   terminal: SUPERSEDED | REVERSED
# RESOLUTION_STATUS vocab (contradictions): RESOLVED | UNRESOLVED   (an unresolved conflict STAYS UNRESOLVED; verdict='-')
# CHECKER enforces:
#   - in-band STATUS header present (or hash-bound companion sidecar)
#         [REQ: in-band STATUS header (or hash-bound companion for TSV)]
#   - every DECISIONS row non-empty in: choice, alternatives, evidence, evidence_date, decision_state, confidence
#         [REQ: each decision row: choice, alternatives, evidence, evidence-date, decision-state, confidence]
#   - every CONTRADICTIONS row non-empty in: claim_a, claim_b_or_live_evidence, verdict, winning_owner, resolution_status
#         [REQ: each contradiction row: claim-A, claim-B/live-evidence, verdict, winning-owner, resolution-status]
#   - decision_state is ONE token from the vocab above; concatenated qualifiers rejected
#         [REQ: decision-state vocabulary separates existence from adoption from efficacy (no concatenated qualifiers)]
#   - NO_SILENT_MERGE: a contradiction verdict names the winner (claim_a OR claim_b, verbatim) OR resolution_status=UNRESOLVED;
#     a third synthesized claim not equal to A or B is prohibited
#         [REQ: NO_SILENT_MERGE enforced: a third synthesized claim is prohibited; record both + adjudicate or retain UNRESOLVED]
#   - each conflict_id here is the resolvable target of DDC-02's known_conflict_ids
# ## STATE face — DECISIONS (supersede a row IN PLACE when decision_state transitions)
decision_id
# ## STATE face — CONTRADICTIONS (record BOTH claims; adjudicate or retain UNRESOLVED — never merge)
conflict_id
